fault_cut.cut: SIGKILL the separate File provider after the Listing Attempt is running and the HTTP Listing request has started

invariants: the provider is a separately authenticated and attached daemon, not an in-process Artifact stub
the process is killed only after the Listing Attempt is running and the controlled origin has accepted the HTTP request
the expired Attempt produces no accepted Artifact or business result and its Permit is released
the Attempt persists its originating dispatch; expiry settles that replay identity and atomically creates a fresh recovery dispatch
the fresh dispatch creates a distinct Listing Attempt instead of replaying the expired Offer command
the recovered provider stores the successful Listing and all 20 Detail responses, and the DailyRun closes normally
after an Atoll Server restart both execution and File provider daemons reconnect and response bytes remain readable
